detail.quote: However, upon closer inspection, this conclusion is actually valid because if not all Hunan people like pepper, it implies that some pepper lovers must be outside Hunan.
detail.explanation: That implication is invalid. The premise can be true when some Hunan residents dislike pepper and every pepper-lover is from Hunan, making the conclusion false. The same kind of unsupported reversal also appears in the candidate’s claim that D is valid, so the claim that C is the only invalid option is not established.
